  have hS (b : ℤ) : b ∈ S ↔ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b := by
    change IsUnit (b : K) ↔ _

  have hb0 (b : ℤ) (hb : b ∈ S) : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by

    refine (isLocalization_iff S (R p)).mpr ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro b

      apply isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr
      refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (b.val : ℚ) * (b.val : ℚ)⁻¹ = 1
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (hb0 b.val b.property)
    · intro r
      obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hr⟩ := (h_T008.1 (r : ℚ)).mp r.property
      refine ⟨(a, ⟨b, (hS b).mpr hb⟩), ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (r : ℚ) * (b : ℚ) = (a : ℚ)
      rw [hr, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hb0 b ((hS b).mpr hb))]
    · intro a b hab
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      have he : a = b := by

      simp [he]

      ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b → κ r = (a : K) * (b : K)⁻¹ := by
    intro a b r hr hb
    have hbr : r * (b : R p) = (a : R p) := by

      change (r : ℚ) * (b : ℚ) = (a : ℚ)
      rw [hr, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hb0 b ((hS b).mpr hb))]

    exact (eq_div_iff (by simpa [CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff K p] using hb)).mpr hk

    rfl

    | zero => simp [throughR]
    | add a b ha hb => simp_all [throughR]

      | zero => simp [throughR]
      | add a b ha hb => simp_all [throughR, TensorProduct.tmul_add]

    TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange ℤ (ZMod p) K K (MR p M)
  let D : FK p K M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M := F.trans (E.symm.trans C)

    change C ((E.symm) (((a : ZMod p) • c) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m))) = _
    change (κ r * ((algebraMap (ZMod p) K a) * c)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m = _
    have hcast : algebraMap (ZMod p) K a = (ZMod.cast a : K) := rfl
    rw [hcast]

  have hDi : ∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (w : FK p K M),

    intro f w
    induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp [throughF]
    | add a b ha hb => simp_all [throughF]
    | tmul c u =>
      induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp [throughF]
      | add a b ha hb => simp_all [throughF, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
      | tmul a u =>
        induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
        | zero => simp [throughF]
        | add u v hu hv => simp_all [throughF, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
        | tmul r m => rfl
